messages.subject: problems in wallace (v 1.0.6)
parts:
Hello everyone

 

Thank you for accepting me in the group.

I have several problems with the use of Wallace. I am using wallace (v1.0.6), the occurrence and environmental data specified by the user.

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: problems in wallace (v 1.0.6)
parts:
Hi Angela,

Thanks for your valuable feedback in the upcoming version of Wallace (v1.0.5.9000). Notice the change of the version, we will change to v1.0.6 once the newest version is submitted to CRAN.

About your comments, I was able to reproduce the error in module 7 (download the prediction raster) that is fixed in v.1.0.5.9000. Please, install Wallace again using the following code and let me know if the the error was fixed:

> devtools::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace@maxnet")

Unfortunately, I did not reproduce the problems in module 2 and 8. Can you give more information about them? I'm very curious about the occurrence file that you are using in your analysis. Maybe, the issue is there.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject: Re: problems in wallace (v 1.0.6)
parts:
Hi folks,

While model successfully performed in Wallace GUI, in the RStudio i have several lines of the following warning

  • 17366 grid cells found with at least one NA value: these cells were excluded from raster predictions.
  • Warning in arrows(res$rm[seq(j, s, fc)], y[seq(j, s, fc)] + v[seq(j, s,  : zero-length arrow is of indeterminate angle and so skipped
  • 17366 grid cells found with at least one NA value: these cells were excluded from raster predictions. 
  • Warning in cor(x, y) : the standard deviation is zero
  • ENMeval completed in 1 minutes 24.4 seconds.
• Warning: Error in [[: attempt to select less than one element in get1index

At GUI message window i have the following

    **WELCOME TO WALLACE***
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Please find messages for the user in this log window.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    > User-specified CSV file SpiderMan.csv with total of 25 records with
    coordinates was uploaded.
    > Environmental predictors: User input.
    ! WARNING : Removed records without environmental values with occIDs: 24 .
    > Study extent: bounding box. Study extent buffered by 0.3 degrees.
    > Study extent: bounding box. Study extent buffered by 0.28 degrees.
    > Study extent: bounding box. Study extent buffered by 0.25 degrees.
    > Environmental data masked.
    > Random background points sampled (n = 2500 ).
    > Occurrences partitioned by random k-fold (k = 2 ).
    > Maxent ran successfully using maxnet and output evaluation results for
    16 clamped models.
    > Maxent cloglog clamped model prediction plotted.

    Any idea on how this messages affect the model quality ?

    Data are over Crete island - Greece, 25 points of virtual species nicely distributed over the island and CHELSA climate raster data at 1km.

    Looking forward

    Dimitris

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: problems in wallace (v 1.0.6)
parts:
Dimitris,

Most of those warnings or errors are safe to ignore -- they deal with models that had zero predictors or UI errors that quickly resolve themselves. In the next version, we'll try to remove them. The one that you may want to check out is the warning that 17366 grid cells have at least one raster with an NA value. That means that predictions cannot be made to these cells.
-----------------------------------------------------------
Jamie M. Kass, Ph.D.
Dept. of Biology
City College of New York, CUNY Graduate Center
